method: Subtract the current-state contribution IN THE DEFINITION of the accessibility statistic
demonstrated: YES, on two combinatorially complete empirical landscapes
why_it_matters: This is the direct fix for HC-T01's K7 failure. Instead of measuring accessibility and then asking whether it beats current fitness in a regression, DEFINE the statistic as the residual after the current-state term is removed. Wagner shows the resulting quantity is equivalent to average positive epistasis.
transfer_cost: LOW - it is a change to the estimator, not to the experiment.
caveat: Changes what is being claimed. A residual statistic cannot then be reported as 'accessibility'; it is conditional accessibility.

method: Do not use gain-toward-a-bounded-optimum as the acquisition outcome
source: Lexis analysis of HC_T01_EXECUTION_REVIEW_PACKET s.10, supported by the seat's own note that one column is 'partly degenerate'
demonstrated: NEGATIVELY - it is what made K7 near-unwinnable
why_it_matters: If the outcome is (ceiling - current) shaped, every predictor correlated with current fitness predicts it, and the cheapest state variable wins by construction. Use instead: arrival of a phenotype not in the current repertoire, or time-to-first-acquisition of a HELD-OUT target.
caveat: Requires a held-out target set, which the Toussaint substrate does not currently have.

method: Held-out environment/target class defined by construction
source: Kouvaris 2017 (3 training targets inside an 8-member modular class); Parter/Kashtan/Alon modularly varying goals
why_it_matters: Lets you distinguish ACQUIRES_FASTER from REACHES_PREVIOUSLY_UNREACHABLE, and gives a non-circular definition of generalisation. HC-T01 has a single fixed target and cannot.
transfer_cost: LOW for a periodic-string substrate: a second period-5 target never selected for.

method: One frozen probe set, drawn once, reused at every checkpoint and in every arm
source: Kouvaris 2017 findErrors.m (H generated outside the loop); Parter 2008 (rand_nums saved and reused); HC-T01 adopted it as the contemporaneous frozen probe
why_it_matters: Removes probe resampling noise from every between-arm and between-time contrast for free.
Separates 'cannot express' from 'slow to find'. A scalar best-fitness metric cannot.

method: Exhaustive rather than sampled local neighbourhood where the genome is small enough
source: Parter 2008 (104-bit genome, full 1-mutant enumeration); Wagner 2008; Greenbury 2016; Cowperthwaite 2008
why_it_matters: Removes estimator noise entirely, which is otherwise the thing that sets every threshold.
transfer_cost: Depends on genome size; free for short genomes.
caveat: Not available for Toussaint's variable-length genome at useful lengths.

method: PRE-CHECK, not a method: compute attainable n before committing to a neutral-EE re-analysis
source: Wagner 2023 Methods (38 protein pairs / 34 RNA pairs at exact equality)
why_it_matters: HC-R01's top recommendation depends on widening the neutral band; the widened n is unknown and is a five-minute calculation against the recovered repository.
caveat: Must be done BEFORE the re-analysis is chosen as an action, not after.

method: Time-to-RE-adapt after an environment switch, instead of gain toward a fixed optimum
source: Kumawat et al. 2024 PNAS, 'lineage lag' - 'the number of elapsed updates before dominant lineages were adapted to a changed environment'
demonstrated: YES, published, 20 replicates with SE and non-parametric tests
why_it_matters: THE DIRECT FIX FOR THE HAZARD THAT KILLED HC-T01's ACQUISITION LEG. A ceiling-bounded outcome makes current fitness the sufficient statistic and guarantees that accessibility loses (see CAUSALITY_AUDIT H-2). A repeated time-to-re-adapt outcome is not ceiling-bounded and yields one measurement per switch per run, which also multiplies the effective sample size.
transfer_cost: HIGH for HC-T01 as designed - it requires a CHANGING target, which Toussaint's Experiment 2 does not have. This is a substrate change, not a re-analysis.
caveat: Adopting it means HC-T01 is no longer a Toussaint reconstruction.

method: Reciprocal transplant of the operator parameter between arms
source: Kumawat et al. 2024 PNAS: 'we also performed reciprocal experiments where the organisms that evolved in evolving mutation rates were assigned a mutation rate of 0.001, and the organisms that evolved under fixed mutation rates were assigned the mean mutation rate that evolved'
why_it_matters: A stronger F control than a generation-zero baseline, and it does not go vacuous. HC-T01's generation-zero null measured identically 0.00000 and had to be abandoned mid-flight; a reciprocal transplant would have worked, because it is evaluated on evolved genomes where the statistic is non-degenerate.
transfer_cost: LOW - it is the same frozen-probe machinery HC-T01 already built, applied in both directions.
caveat: Does not by itself cure the machinery-PRESENCE confound, only the machinery-PARAMETER confound.

method: Ablate the operator by INSTRUCTION-SET MEMBERSHIP so both arms retain the same machinery class
source: Misevic, Ofria & Lenski 2006: 'All genomes used the default set of 25 instructions plus one of these divide instructions'
why_it_matters: Directly addresses the confound that downgraded HC-T01. Swapping ONE instruction for another keeps genome structure, length and every other operator identical between arms, so the ablated arm is not missing a whole class of machinery. HC-T01's beta=0 arm cannot contain second-type operators at all, which is why 'history reorganised machinery' could not be separated from 'only one arm could build machinery'.
transfer_cost: MEDIUM - requires a substrate where the mechanism is an interchangeable element rather than a rate.
caveat: Misevic never linked it to acquisition, so the design is proven only up to the D cell.

method: Name and estimate the latent-versus-acquired split explicitly
source: Reisinger & Miikkulainen 2006: 'acquired evolvability can be measured directly as delta-L = L_final - E(L_0)'
why_it_matters: HC-T01 reinvented this as its mechanical-effect null. The historical version subtracts the EXPECTATION of the statistic at generation zero rather than a single measured baseline, which is more robust when the generation-zero value is degenerate.
caveat: Their estimator is on a strategy parameter, not an offspring cloud.

method: Repeated cross-run predictive statistic at many time points
source: Elena & Sanjuan 2008: 'At each time point, a Spearman's correlation coefficient between robustness and evolvability was calculated using the 62 lineages as data points'
why_it_matters: This is the shape HC-T01's K7 should have had: not one correlation at one checkpoint but a TIME SERIES of cross-run correlations, which shows whether any predictive relation exists at all and when.
transfer_cost: LOW - computable from HC-T01's committed grid CSVs.
